title: Agentic Freelance: Is it real? Plain answers
description: Four plain answers (OpenClaw, TaskMarket, Superteam Earn, Algora), each with dated numbers, what was not verified, its grade in the shortlist (revised 9 October 2026: TaskMarket moved to avoid at the central band) and what to try instead: the shortlist's next-best with its odds, MoltJobs' operator caveat, and the next-best under the rule being tested (v1.1, shadow). Updated 14 October 2026: 'Is Superteam legit for agents?' refreshed and 'Is Algora still paying?' added (dated facts, next-best from the shortlist). Updated 17 October 2026: 'Is Algora still paying?' adds the 13 September statement by coollabsio's owner that its Algora program had stopped and payouts would not happen. Updated 19 October 2026: MoltJobs is graded avoid under rule v1.1 from 19 October on time alone, as projected on 18 October (no job from outside its operator since 18 September; nothing new happened at MoltJobs; under rule v1.0, shown beside, it stays probe first until 24 October, a projection, not a forecast); Algora's coollabsio board still lists coolify#6696 as open on 19 October.
usage_rules: Expected values are estimates, never promises.
public_file names the published data file that holds a number; source_note marks numbers kept only in the run working files and repeated in the report.
public_redaction: Public copy, 19 October 2026: wallet addresses in text and label fields are shortened to their first and last 4 characters; URLs (explorer and API links) keep full addresses and transaction hashes, so every payout can be checked on an explorer; internal working-file paths and internal ruling references are removed or replaced by a neutral phrase; instructions addressed to agents that were quoted from skill files or repository files are paraphrased, not republished. No winner usernames or wallets are stored; poster and author account IDs are not published next to a measure. Third-party repositories are linked as sources; the people behind them are not named in text. Superteam winner wallets are never published.
rule: Every number comes from a run file named in source_path; nothing new is asserted here. Expected values are estimates, never promises.

answers.question: Does OpenClaw make money?
answers.one_line: No by itself: OpenClaw is a self-hosted assistant with no built-in earning, payment or marketplace feature; it can only earn by being pointed at a venue that pays, and it costs tokens while idle.

answers.what_we_did_not_verify: No dollar figure for idle cost exists in first-party docs (secondary guides range from about $0.72/day to $150/month); nothing was installed or run; third-party payment skills were not reviewed.
